item.title: IIT Madras hosts conference on urban climate resilience; launches India Sustainability Report
item.description: Over 90 international researchers and policymakers gathered at IIT Madras for the Cities of Care Conference. The Sustainable India 2025 report documenting climate action across the country was also launched.

item.title: Aerospace manufacturer JJG Aero raises $30M in Series B round from Norwest
item.description: JJG Aero, which serves marquee clients including Collins Aerospace, Safran, and GE Aerospace, has grown at a 35% CAGR over the past three years and plans to use the funds for capacity addition and vertical integration.

item.title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman presents Budget 2026, continues record-breaking tenure
item.description: FM Nirmala Sitharaman will present her record ninth consecutive Union Budget on February 1, Sunday, outlining the government's revenue and expenditure plans for the next financial year.

item.title: Union Budget 2026 proposes setting up of rare earth corridors in 4 states
item.description: India’s dependence on imports of rare earth magnets was spotlighted last year when China imposed export restrictions on these critical components, impacting sectors like automotive and EVs.

item.title: How Propelld is rebuilding education lending in India
item.description: In this episode of the Prime Venture Partners Podcast, Victor Senapaty, Co-founder and CEO of Propelld, discusses how the company is reshaping education financing in India, having disbursed Rs 4,000 crore to over 400,000 students.

item.title: Government launches Rs 10,000 Cr Biopharma Shakti Programme to strengthen sector
item.description: A Rs 10,000-crore push aims to build India’s biopharma and advanced manufacturing capabilities as disease patterns and technology priorities shift.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: Govt increases outlay for electronics component manufacturing to Rs 40,000 Cr
item.description: India’s electronics sector is now the third-largest and fastest-growing export category in FY25, from the seventh-largest export category in FY22, the Economic Survey 2025-26 noted.

item.title: Delhivery chairman Deepak Kapoor, Director Saugata Gupta to exit board in April
item.description: Delhivery will see its Chairman and an independent director exit in April, continuing a board refresh that brought in four new directors last year, including executives from Emcure Pharmaceuticals, boAt Lifestyle, and PB Fintech.

item.title: Can't afford a full-time CTO? This startup offers tech leadership on subscription
item.description: Bengaluru startup Profound IQ solves the technical leadership gap for early-stage startups through fractional CTO services.

item.title: Budget 2026: Government to deploy 15,000 animation labs in schools
item.description: The budget also proposes establishing a new National Institute of Design through a challenge route to address shortages in the design sector, where domestic talent hasn't kept pace with industry growth.
